texts.orig: Purpose: To record all training completed by site study staff members that is not otherwise documented by a training completion certificate
texts.text: Purpose: To record all training completed by site study staff members that is not otherwise documented by a training completion certificate

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Audience/User: Study coordinators, principal investigators, other site staff, clinical monitor
texts.text: Audience/User: Study coordinators, principal investigators, other site staff, clinical monitor

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Details: This tracking log should provide a comprehensive list of all training completed by site study staff that is not documented by other written means, such as a completion certificate. It is required for both observational and interventional clinical research studies.
texts.text: Details: This tracking log should provide a comprehensive list of all training completed by site study staff that is not documented by other written means, such as a completion certificate. It is required for both observational and interventional clinical research studies.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Record training in the log as it is completed, to ensure completeness and accuracy of the data.
texts.text: Record training in the log as it is completed, to ensure completeness and accuracy of the data.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · This log need not include training that is documented by a completion certificate or other written documentation.
texts.text: This log need not include training that is documented by a completion certificate or other written documentation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · The site study staff member listed on each line should sign to verify that the training has been completed.
texts.text: The site study staff member listed on each line should sign to verify that the training has been completed.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Number each page and maintain this log in the Essential Documents Binder, behind the Clinical Research and Study Training tab. (Synonyms for this binder include Investigator Binder, Regulatory Binder, Investigator Site File [ISF], and Study File.)
texts.text: Number each page and maintain this log in the Essential Documents Binder, behind the Clinical Research and Study Training tab. (Synonyms for this binder include Investigator Binder, Regulatory Binder, Investigator Site File [ISF], and Study File.)

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Store pages in reverse chronological order, with the newest pages of the log placed at the front of the section.
texts.text: Store pages in reverse chronological order, with the newest pages of the log placed at the front of the section.

texts.orig: · At the conclusion of the study, identify the final page of the log by checking the box in the footer.
